note: Every folder ships its estimation data, so each model can be run on its own in any order. The order below is the order of dependence if data are rebuilt or coefficients change.

order.reason: not a choice model: rebuilds the TASHA frequency, start-time, duration and joint distributions from the survey; independent of the others
tour mode models first: their coefficients define the mode-choice logsum used by the stop models (00_shared_data/mode_choice_logsums/m08_coef.csv)
tour mode, school (coefficients also in m09_coef.csv); no published location model uses its logsum
tour mode, shopping: logsum of the shopping stop model
tour mode, other: logsum of the recreation, accompanying and other stop models
joint household shopping tours; no other model depends on it
joint household recreation and other tours; no other model depends on it
primary destination of discretionary tours; uses car generalised time, not the logsum
stop location; reads the logsum of the tour mode models (run after 14-17 if their coefficients change, rebuilding input data)
stop location; logsum of the other-tour mode model
stop location; logsum of the other-tour mode model
stop location; logsum of the other-tour mode model
location of the first stop of an outing from the workplace
work business location, workers with a usual workplace
work business location, other persons
work trips of at-home workers
school without a record and daycare, pooled
outing during a work episode (binary logit)
mode of the outing (binary logit)
return home between episodes (binary logit)
mode of the legs of transit tours; not in the article
